title: Mother and Toddler Relaxing on Beach, 1950s Vintage B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A charming mid-20th century black-and-white snapshot capturing a young mother and her curly-haired toddler resting on a beach blanket on a sunny sandy shore. The mother wears a mid-century sleeveless top and shorts, smiling toward the camera, while the little girl sits beside a beach bucket and toys. The photograph features distinctive scalloped deckled edges typical of 1950s personal photography.
